methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing was collected for each vendor on the accessed date. Where official vendor plan pages returned HTTP 406/503/timeout/CAPTCHA or rendered JS-only, pricing was independently re-verified on 2026-06-14 against official vendor help/support pages (instacart.com/instacart-plus, help.shipt.com pricing pages, kroger.com/pr/boost/faq, help.doordash.com) and reputable price-tracking comparison sources (dealnews.com). VERIFIER CORRECTIONS (2026-06-14): (1) Amazon Prime monthly corrected from a stale $12.99 (the 2018 rate) to the current $14.99/month confirmed by dealnews.com and multiple 2026 sources; annual $139/year unchanged. (2) Shipt monthly plan ($10.99/month) added — it is published self-serve on help.shipt.com and was previously omitted. (3) Target Circle 360 monthly plan ($10.99/month) added — published self-serve on help.shipt.com (Shipt powers Target Circle 360). (4) Kroger Boost corrected to its actual two-tier structure with monthly options: Boost Essential ($69/year or $8.99/month) and Boost ($99/year or $12.99/month), confirmed via thekrazycouponlady.com and grocerydive.com following the April 10 2025 price change. For all plans: minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall are null (non-telephony vertical). hipaa/baa are null (consumer grocery delivery, no PHI). For plans billed annually, monthlyUsd is the annualized monthly equivalent (annual total divided by 12); the month-to-month rate and annual total are noted. annualDiscountPct is calculated where both monthly and annual rates are published.
